faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NCL Executive Programme Exam Passed Trainee (Company Secretary) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 10th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have successfully completed the Executive Programme and the Executive Development Programme from the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the NCL Executive Programme Exam Passed Trainee (Company Secretary) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the prevailing government norms and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this contractual role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 22,000/- for the duration of the contract period.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for this position?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a merit list prepared from the aggregate passing percentage of the Executive Programme, followed by a document scrutiny phase.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this NCL job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL), a subsidiary of Coal India Limited.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Executive Programme Exam Passed Trainee (Company Secretary) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of NCL, www.nclcil.in. The direct link to the notification PDF is provided in the Important Links section.
